During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''shipyard''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was used as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] for a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] team captured by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], until the scouts were rescued by [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]].
